US Blacklists Megaspeed Amid Nvidia Export Control Scandal

The United States has added Singaporean company Megaspeed to its Entity List, a trade blacklist that restricts access to American technology. This action follows accusations that Megaspeed funneled AI chips to China, reportedly after a former executive's affair with Nvidia CEO Jensen Huang became public. Singapore is also investigating Megaspeed. The US Commerce Department's decision restricts companies from accessing American technology without a special government license.
